title: Garam Masala

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: The aromatic blend used throughout the book. Grind it at home; the canned or packet kind is a poor substitute.

steps.action: Toast in a small dry pan over high, stirring, until slightly darker and fragrant; do not burn:
Grind to a fine powder in a spice grinder:
